gloss: to emphasize; to attach importance to; to take seriously

definitions.gloss: to emphasize; to attach importance to; to take seriously
definitions.explanation: To regard something as important or significant and give it priority or special attention. Used when discussing values, policies, and priorities.

examples.japanese: ⟦{品質|ひんしつ}→品質：09507_hinshitsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{重視|じゅうし}する。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{社員|しゃいん}→社員：03065_shain⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{健康|けんこう}→健康：02706_kenkou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{重視|じゅうし}して⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: This company places importance on employee health.

notes:
A formal word frequently used in business, education, and policy contexts to express what is prioritized or valued. The noun form ⟦{重視|じゅうし}→重視：03341_juushi⟧ often appears in compound expressions.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{品質|ひんしつ}→品質：09507_hinshitsu⟧⟦{重視|じゅうし}→重視：03341_juushi⟧: quality-oriented
- ⟦{安全|あんぜん}→安全：01131_anzen⟧⟦{重視|じゅうし}→重視：03341_juushi⟧: safety-first
- ⟦{成果|せいか}→成果：06745_seika⟧⟦{重視|じゅうし}→重視：03341_juushi⟧: results-oriented
- ⟦{顧客|こきゃく}→顧客：08632_kokyaku⟧⟦{重視|じゅうし}→重視：03341_juushi⟧: customer-focused
- ⟦{実績|じっせき}→実績：04214_jisseki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{重視|じゅうし}する: to value track record

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{大切|たいせつ}にする→大切にする：26940_taisetsunisuru⟧: to value — more personal and emotional
- ⟦{重|おも}んじる→重んじる：14445_omonjiru⟧: to esteem — literary, emphasizes respect
- {軽視|けいし}する: to make light of — the antonym, to treat as unimportant
